description: See exactly which pixels changed in an image before you approve it. Before, Diff and After sit side by side, with changed pixels highlighted over a white background, over the new image, or blinking, plus a changed-pixel count. Git LFS images render in place in BB's Diff tab, downloading missing objects on demand. A pinned Image diff tab lists every changed image in the thread, and opening a changed image anywhere shows its diff. LFS images need git-lfs on the host.
